PICK YOUR SIZE

Which dumpster do you need?

You don't have to guess. Two options — a 17-yard for most jobs, a 25-yard for the big ones. Here's what fits in each. Still on the fence? Ask the bot or just call us.

💡

Not sure which size you need?

Tap the chat bubble in the corner — our recommender will walk you through it in under a minute.

17yd

Most projects

STANDARD ROLL-OFF
  • Single-room cleanout
  • Garage purge
  • Small to mid-size roof repair
  • Bathroom remodel
  • Yard & storm debris
Fits: ~6–8 pickup truck loads
MOST POPULAR
25yd

Bigger jobs

LARGE ROLL-OFF
  • Whole-house cleanout
  • Kitchen or full remodel
  • Full roof tear-off
  • Construction debris
  • Estate cleanouts
Fits: ~10–12 pickup truck loads

ABOUT

A handshake still means something.

CD Dumpster & Disposal is a locally owned dumpster rental and junk removal company serving Corpus Christi and the surrounding Coastal Bend. We were founded on the same standards we held in uniform — show up on time, do the work right, treat every customer's property like our own.

Whether you're clearing your garage on a Saturday or running a job site Monday morning, you get straight answers, fair pricing, and a crew that respects your time. Same call. Same crew.
